The climate in Nice

Nice is about 29 m above sea level. The warmest month is August, with an average high of 29°C; the coldest is January, when nights average 5°C. Around 780 mm of precipitation falls in a year on average, most of it in October (about 131 mm).

Best time to visit Nice

The most pleasant weather in Nice is usually in June and September: average highs are around 25°C, with up to 7 days of rain a month.
